name: The Keys
blurb: One road, too many bridges, and a deputy who has seen everything twice.

signs.text: BRIDGE ICES BEFORE ROAD. IT IS 91 DEGREES.
NEXT GAS 40 MI. NEXT REGRET 2 MI.
IGUANAS HAVE RIGHT OF WAY. LEGALLY UNCLEAR.

billboards.text: OWN A PIECE OF PARADISE. SOME PIECES STILL ABOVE WATER.
WRECKED LIVE. NEW EPISODES EVERY CRASH.

meta.notes: M1 stub; the traffic lane owns this file in M1. The mix weights equal the sim's per-category defaults (car 5, truck 2), because SimConfig does not carry the mix yet: see the traffic-1 changes note. For the same reason the pedestrian and animal weights are all 1, which is how sim/peds picks them (evenly within a list; a `pedestrians` roadside zone gets the odd stray animal): see the traffic-2 changes note. The signs and billboards are the placeholder items from the content-pack doc's region stub (M2 traffic-3), for road-3's `billboard` slots; each id is stable, so the in-game veto can name it.
